scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:mcp && npm run build -w packages/console && npm run build:app
scripts.build:console: npm run build:core && npm run build -w packages/console
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w packages/console && npm run typecheck -w packages/mcp-server && npm --prefix packages/app run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm test -w packages/console && npm test -w packages/mcp-server
scripts.test:baseline: npm run build:core && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.0 emulators:exec --config tests/baseline/firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-baseline "cd packages/console && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 ../../tests/baseline/*.test.ts"
